prompt: Earlier technological development brought more changes to the life of ordinary people than recent technological development do. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
Technological development has transformed human life dramatically over the past few centuries. Some people argue that inventions made the past brought greater changes  to the lives of ordinary people than modern technological advancements. I disagree with this view because, although earlier inventions had a profound impact, recent technologies have affected a wider range of everyday activities and have made these changes more rapid and widespread.

There is no doubt that earlier technological developments significantly improved  people's lives. The invention and widespread use of electricity; for example, revolutionised homes, workplaces and public services. Similarly, cars and other forms of modern transportation made it possible for people to travel much faster and over great distances. The telephone has transformed communication by allowing individuals to contact relatives, friends and businesses without having to meet in person. these inventions laid the foundations for many aspects of  modern society and were particularly important in improving living standards.

However, recent technological developments have arguably brought even more extensive changes to everyday life. The internet and smartphones have  made communication almost instantaneous, enabling people to make video calls, share information and maintain relationships regardless of geographical distance. Technology has also transformed the way people work and study. Employees can now work remotely, while students can attend online courses and access vast amounts of educational material from their homes. In addition, online banking, shopping and digital payment systems have made routine activities considerably faster and more convenient. More recently, artificial intelligence has begun to influence areas such as healthcare, education and employment, suggesting that the impact of modern technology will continue to grow.

In conclusion, earlier technological inventions undoubtedly brought revolutionary changes, particularly through improvements in  electricity, transport and communication. Nevertheless, I believe that recent technological developments have had a greater overall influence because they have transformed almost every aspect of daily life and continue to evolve at an unprecedented pace,
